title: INSERT OR IGNORE idempotency is correct and well-tested
description: INSERT OR IGNORE for idempotent puts is correct for a content-addressed store: same CID always means same content, so silently skipping a duplicate is always safe. The idempotent put test verifies COUNT(*) == 1 after two puts of the same data — this is the right oracle. A future contributor might suggest UPSERT or replacing on conflict; don't — INSERT OR IGNORE is correct because content-addressed blocks are immutable.
